sub-flow.name: pf-rollback
sub-flow.doc:description: Open a revert PR restoring the repo to pre-upgrade state. Non-fatal.

http:request.doc:name: GET upgrade commit (find pre-upgrade base)
http:request.doc:description: Fetch the upgrade commit to extract its first parent SHA (=changePlan.headSha)

http:request.doc:name: GET base commit (extract pre-upgrade tree SHA)
http:request.doc:description: Fetch the pre-upgrade commit object to get its tree SHA

http:request.doc:name: GET current default-branch HEAD
http:request.doc:description: Fetch the current HEAD of the default branch to anchor the revert branch

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Build create revert-branch ref body

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ref: ("refs/heads/" ++ vars.revertBranch), sha: vars.defHeadSha }

http:request.doc:name: POST create revert branch ref
http:request.doc:description: Create the revert branch anchored at the current default-branch HEAD

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: ("Revert Java 17 upgrade (" ++ vars.jobId ++ ") â€” deploy failed"), tree: vars.baseTreeSha, parents: [vars.defHeadSha] }

http:request.doc:name: POST create revert commit
http:request.doc:description: Commit that restores the repo to the pre-upgrade tree

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Build update revert-branch ref body

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sha: vars.revertCommit.sha, force: false }

http:request.doc:name: PATCH move revert branch to revert commit
http:request.doc:description: Point the revert branch at the new revert commit SHA

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { title: ("Revert: Java 17 upgrade " ++ vars.appName), head: vars.revertBranch, base: vars.coords.defaultBranch, body: ("Automated rollback for job " ++ vars.jobId ++ " â€” the CD deploy failed." ++ (if (vars.jiraTicketId != null) ("\n\n- Jira: [" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ "](" ++ (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ ")") else "")), maintainer_can_modify: true }

http:request.doc:name: POST open revert PR
http:request.doc:description: Open the revert PR; response contains html_url

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record for revertPrUrl update

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Merge revertPrUrl into job record

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- payload mergeWith { revertPrUrl: vars.revertPrUrl, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

os:store.doc:name: OS Store job record with revertPrUrl

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record (restore to payload for caller)

sub-flow.name: pf-open-pr
sub-flow.doc:description: Open a GitHub Pull Request for the upgrade branch and persist prUrl to the job record.

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Build create-PR body
ee:transform.doc:description: Compose the GitHub PR payload: title, head branch, base branch, body, flags

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { title: ("Java 17 upgrade: " ++ vars.appName ++ " â†’ " ++ vars.changePlan.targetRuntime ++ " / Java " ++ vars.changePlan.targetJavaVersion), head: vars.branchName, base: vars.coords.defaultBranch, body: ("Automated Java 17 upgrade for **" ++ vars.appName ++ "**.

" ++ "- Target runtime: " ++ vars.changePlan.targetRuntime ++ "
" ++ "- Target Java: " ++ vars.changePlan.targetJavaVersion ++ "
" ++ "- Commit: " ++ vars.commitSha ++ "
" ++ "- Job: " ++ vars.jobId ++ (if (vars.jiraTicketId != null) ("
- Jira: [" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ "](" ++ (p('jira.baseUrl') default '') ++ "/browse/" ++ (vars.jiraTicketId as String) ++ ")") else "")), maintainer_can_modify: true, draft: false }

http:request.doc:name: POST create Pull Request
http:request.doc:description: Create the GitHub PR; response contains number and html_url

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record for PR update

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Merge prNumber + prUrl into job record
ee:transform.doc:description: Persist prNumber and prUrl; status unchanged â€” caller sets PR_OPEN via pf-set-status

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- payload mergeWith { prNumber: vars.prNumber, prUrl: vars.prUrl, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

os:store.doc:name: OS Store job record with PR details

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END pf-open-pr
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END pf-open-pr | PR created | prNumber=' ++ vars.prNumber ++ ' | prUrl=' ++ (vars.prUrl default '?')]

sub-flow.name: pf-atomic-commit
sub-flow.doc:description: Commit all staged files as one Git commit on a new branch via GitHub Git Data API.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO START pf-atomic-commit enter
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'START - pf-atomic-commit enter | stagedFiles=' ++ sizeOf(vars.stagedFiles default []) ++ ' | headSha=' ++ (vars.changePlan.headSha default '?')]

http:request.doc:name: GET HEAD commit (stale-plan check)
http:request.doc:description: Fetch current HEAD SHA to verify the repo has not moved since the change plan was computed

choice.doc:name: CHOICE stale plan?
choice.doc:description: Reject if the branch HEAD has moved since pf-assess-app captured it

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR stale plan
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'stale plan: repo HEAD=' ++ (vars.headCheck.sha default '?') ++ ' != plan headSha=' ++ (vars.changePlan.headSha default '?')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE CONFLICT:STALE_PLAN
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The repo HEAD moved since assessment (current=' ++ (vars.headCheck.sha default '?') ++ ', plan=' ++ (vars.changePlan.headSha default '?') ++ '). Re-run assess_app to get a fresh changePlan.']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO stale-plan check passed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'stale-plan check passed | headSha matches plan']

set-variable.doc:name: PV SET branchBase
set-variable.doc:description: Deterministic base branch name before collision handling

http:request.doc:name: GET matching branch refs
http:request.doc:description: List existing branches sharing the base name so a free suffix can be chosen

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO branch name computed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'branch name computed | branchBase=' ++ vars.branchBase ++ ' | branchName=' ++ vars.branchName ++ ' | existing=' ++ sizeOf(vars.existingRefs default [])]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { ref: ("refs/heads/" ++ vars.branchName), sha: vars.changePlan.headSha }

http:request.doc:name: POST create branch ref
http:request.doc:description: Create the upgrade branch at the current HEAD SHA

foreach.doc:name: FOR EACH staged file â€” create blob

http:request.doc:name: POST create blob
http:request.doc:description: Upload file content as a Git blob; response contains the blob SHA

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.blobs default []) ++ [{ path: vars.currentFile.path, blobSha: (vars.blobResp.sha as String) }]]
set-variable.doc:name: PV APPEND blob to accumulator

http:request.doc:name: POST create tree
http:request.doc:description: Create a new Git tree from blobs; response contains the tree SHA

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: ("Java 17 upgrade (" ++ vars.jobId ++ ")" ++ (if (vars.jiraTicketId != null) (" " ++ vars.jiraTicketId) else "")), tree: vars.treeResp.sha, parents: [vars.changePlan.headSha] }

http:request.doc:name: POST create commit
http:request.doc:description: Create the upgrade commit object; response contains the commit SHA

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO commit created
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'commit created | branchName=' ++ vars.branchName ++ ' | commitSha=' ++ (vars.commitSha default '?')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sha: vars.commitSha, force: false }

http:request.doc:name: PATCH move branch ref to commit
http:request.doc:description: Point the upgrade branch at the new commit SHA

os:store.doc:name: OS Store branch index (branchâ†’jobId)
os:store.doc:description: Index entry read by the webhook handler to map an incoming branch event back to a jobId

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job record for branch/commit update

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Merge branchName + commitSha into job record
ee:transform.doc:description: Persist branchName and commitSha; status is set by pf-start-upgrade via pf-set-status after this flow returns

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import mergeWith from dw::core::Objects import nowUtc from dwl::dates --- payload mergeWith { branchName: vars.branchName, commitSha: vars.commitSha, updatedAt: nowUtc() }

os:store.doc:name: OS Store job record with branch + commit

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END pf-atomic-commit done
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - pf-atomic-commit done | branchName=' ++ vars.branchName ++ ' | commitSha=' ++ (vars.commitSha default '?') ++ ' | stagedFiles=' ++ sizeOf(vars.stagedFiles default [])]
